discordPostHtml:
🚀 TrueWeaponStats (v1.0.0) for Starsector 0.98a (I had to delete the old post to make the home page look nice. Sorry!)

Hey everyone! 👋

Many will remember Unthemed Weapons Utilities by qcwxezda — a great QoL mod that showed calculated weapon stats in Refit. With 0.98a engine changes breaking the original, I modernized and resolved its edge cases under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as an enhanced continuation: True Weapon Stats.

---

🛠 What’s New & Improved:
  • Starsector 0.98a Compatible:

Re-architected UI discovery for 0.98a. Hooks seamlessly from the Fleet screen ([F]), docked at stations, and in planetary menus.

  • Live Weapon Resolution (Built-ins & Unique Hulls):

Queries the actual mounted weapon on the ship instead of isolated mock objects. Fully accounts for built-in superweapons, phase hulls, and slot-specific perks (Ballistic Rangefinder).

  • Clean [ALT] Toggle (Vanilla Aesthetics):

Clean, color-coded combat stats in tooltips. Simply hold [ALT] at any time to instantly view factory vanilla stats without UI clutter.

  • Zero-Config Multilingual Discovery:

Uses runtime JVM bytecode inspection (CargoTooltipFactory.class) to discover localized UI tokens. Works out-of-the-box across all translations (EN, CN, RU, etc.).

  • Refined Combat Math & Safety:

Recalculates flux efficiency (Flux/Damage) against damage buffs, evaluates modifiers multiplicatively matching native engine rules, and guards against zero-division (NaN) crashes.

https://github.com/keltuze/TrueWeaponStats
---

📜 Credits & License
  • qcwxezda — for the original concept, reflection hooks, and foundational calculation logic in Unthemed Weapons Utilities.
  • Released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

The creator of the original idea can take whatever they want from this mod to improve their own mod!
